nodes.label: Double-booking protection (repo check + EXCLUDE USING gist)
nodes.rationale: Two layers: a repository-level pre-insert check (readable error message) plus a DB-level `EXCLUDE USING gist` constraint with predicate `WHERE (status <> 'cancelled')` for race protection. The first migration (alembic/versions/0001_initial.py) creates the btree_gist extension and writes the constraint via raw SQL because SQLAlchemy's declarative API cannot express it.

nodes.label: Soft delete (deleted_at) with partial unique indexes
nodes.rationale: Applied to users, masters, services. Email/phone uniqueness enforced via partial unique indexes (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) rather than unique=True on the column, so soft-deleted rows free up the email/phone for reuse.

nodes.label: Appointment state machine (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS)
nodes.rationale: pending → {confirmed, cancelled}; confirmed → {done, cancelled}; done/cancelled are terminal. Defined in appointment_service.py.

nodes.label: Layered architecture: routes → services → repositories → models
nodes.rationale: Repositories are the sole location containing SQL queries.

nodes.label: Inline WYSIWYG homepage editor (Admin → Settings)
nodes.rationale: Homepage rendering factored into reusable components (AppHeader.vue, HomePreview.vue, AppFooter.vue) with optional editable/content props (default false / from store, so the public site is unaffected). When editable, text nodes render via EditableText.vue and navigational links via EditableLink.vue (a non-navigating span instead of router-link/<a>, so clicking an editable brand/hero button doesn't leave the page). Both mutate the same reactive form object and save via PATCH /api/settings; fields with no direct visual representation (business hours, SEO) are edited in a separate 'More settings' modal.

nodes.label: JWT revocation via token_version counter
nodes.rationale: Each user has a token_version counter embedded in the token payload (ver) at issuance; get_current_user compares it against the current DB value on every request. Logout, password change/reset, and blocking increment the counter, instantly invalidating all previously issued (including compromised) tokens without a denylist or server-side sessions.

nodes.label: Access token in httpOnly cookie (SameSite=Lax, COOKIE_SECURE)
nodes.rationale: JS cannot read the cookie, closing the classic XSS token-theft vector. SameSite=Lax is sufficient CSRF protection for non-GET requests since the app is a pure JSON API with no form-encoded endpoints exploitable by a standard CSRF form. Secure flag is gated by COOKIE_SECURE (not DEBUG) — only when a real TLS terminator sits in front. Token is also returned in the response body of /auth/login, /auth/register, /api/setup for Swagger 'Authorize' and external API clients without cookie access; get_current_user accepts both sources.

nodes.label: VK ID login (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE)
nodes.rationale: First login creates an account or links to an existing one by matching email. Requires VK_CLIENT_ID; without it the 'Login via VK' button auto-hides via GET /api/auth/vk/enabled. Production requires a real HTTPS domain (VK ID disallows IP/localhost outside dev).

nodes.label: Sentry error monitoring (backend + frontend, currently disabled)
nodes.rationale: Code (sentry_sdk.init in backend, Sentry.init in frontend main.js) is wired but inactive without SENTRY_DSN/VITE_SENTRY_DSN. TODO: sentry.io account not yet created (registration returned 403 at setup time). Frontend requires a rebuild, not just a restart, since VITE_SENTRY_DSN is baked into the bundle at `npm run build` time via a Vite build ARG.

nodes.label: DB backup strategy (daily local pg_dump + optional S3)
nodes.rationale: backup-local runs automatically via `docker compose up -d`: daily compressed pg_dump into ./backups with rotation (7 daily / 4 weekly / 6 monthly). Local backups alone don't protect against full VPS/disk loss — recommends rsync/scp offsite or enabling the optional backup-s3 profile.

nodes.label: Caddy as single TLS-terminating entrypoint (auto Let's Encrypt)
nodes.rationale: Caddy obtains/renews the Let's Encrypt certificate automatically; neither nginx nor backend touch TLS. Works over plain HTTP on bare IP before a domain is configured; setting SITE_ADDRESS to a domain and restarting caddy enables HTTPS with no manual Caddyfile edits.

nodes.label: Mailpit fake SMTP server for local dev email
nodes.rationale: backend/config.py defaults already point at Mailpit; password-reset emails are caught at http://localhost:8025 instead of being sent for real.

nodes.label: First-run /setup admin creation wizard
nodes.rationale: /api/setup is necessarily public (no admin exists yet to gate it via RBAC), so outside DEBUG it requires SETUP_TOKEN; without a valid token the wizard gets 403, and the app itself refuses to start when DEBUG=false and SETUP_TOKEN is unset. In DEBUG=true no token is required. Once the first admin exists, /api/setup permanently returns 409.

nodes.label: Salon operates entirely in UTC
nodes.rationale: Master work schedules stored/interpreted as UTC; appointment start_time must arrive timezone-aware and is normalized to UTC; reports bucket days by UTC; frontend displays appointment/slot times as the salon's 'wall clock' (timeZone: 'UTC'), not the browser's local timezone.

nodes.label: Brute-force protection: login lockout + password-reset rate limit
nodes.rationale: Temporary login lockout after 5 failures in 15 minutes (login_attempts log); password-reset requests limited to 3/hour.
